<details>
The PKGBUILD is a standard kernel package build file for the multikernel/linux upstream. It fetches source from the project's own GitHub repository (github.com/multikernel/linux), compiles the kernel using standard `make` commands, and installs artifacts into `$pkgdir` using `install` and `modules_install`. The `eval` usage at the end is a well-known, safe PKGBUILD pattern for generating per-package functions from shared helpers—it evaluates only the output of `declare -f` on functions defined within the file itself, with no external input. No data exfiltration, unexpected network requests, obfuscated payloads, or system tampering are present. All operations are confined to the build directory and the package installation tree.
